_meta.name: Science Knowledge (NAEP)
_meta.source: NCES, National Assessment of Educational Progress
_meta.note: NAEP Science, grade 8, average scale score on the 2009 framework (earlier science assessments used a different framework and are not comparable). Scores rose through 2015, held in 2019, and fell back to the 2009 baseline by 2024. The 0–500-scale NAEP Long-Term Trend and 0–300-scale main assessments are NCES's national probability samples; values are national public+private averages for all students.
_meta.method: NAEP Data Service API, subject=science&grade=8&subscale=SRPUV, year tokens 2009,2011,2015,2019,2024 (suffixed tokens are the pre-accommodations samples), 999-sentinel values dropped
